exact_statement: For every m>=1, Boolean m-bit seed g, p=2^-m, and real K, the paired carrier F_g has the priority physical tree querying x to its first1 at i, then y1..yi, or stopping at g if all x=0. Its costs are Pi_I=2-p(2+I(g)) and Pi_H=4-p(4+H(g)); terminal expected D_K=(K-2)(m-2+2p)+pD_K(g), and query account KPi_I-Pi_H=2(K-2)-p[2(K-2)+D_K(g)], summing to D_K(F)=(K-2)m. For the six-variable three-bit-point-defect carrier, the declared seven-node depth-four tree has ratio (184+9log2(3))/102<496/255, giving gain>524/255>2.05. Minimum expected terminal D2 cut is zero at depth3 and -5/16+(9/64)log2(3) at depth4; therefore4 is the least maximum tree depth giving gain>2 for this specific root.
